README: Shape documented in legacy-web.md, section "README: legacy-web-vectors.json". Every value was produced by EXECUTING the original cZEROde Web v1.1 <script> (harness-web/). No binary fields exist in the stored records (all ciphertext is text); raw file bytes are given as standard padded base64 in *_b64 fields.

meta.binary_encoding: standard base64 (RFC 4648 §4, with = padding) for *_b64 fields; hex for *_hex fields
meta.randomness_note: v2 (Math.random noise/method) and v4/file (random salt+IV) ciphertexts are non-deterministic; they are DECODE vectors. v1 and v3 encoders are deterministic and can be checked both ways.
